english:
A medium-trajectory grenade that splits on impact, releasing 4 seekers that chase after enemies.

Seekers begin chasing enemies that come within 6 meters of them, exploding after dealing damage, or self-destructing after ~2 seconds if their velocity is low.

Each projectile deals <pve 24 /> <pvp [4] /> impact damage twice, then explodes for up to <pve 90 /> <pvp [15] /> damage. The full volley deals up to <pve 552 /> <pvp [92] /> damage.

source.text:
Medium Trajectory | Seekers

Splits on impact, releasing 4 seekers that chase after enemies.

Seekers begin chasing enemies that come within 6 metres of them, exploding after dealing damage, or self-destructing after ~2 seconds if their velocity is low.

Each projectile deals 24 [4] impact damage twice, then explodes for up to 90 [15] damage.
Deals up to 552 [92] damage with all 4 seekers.
Base Cooldown: 151.5 seconds

Chunk Scalar: 0.75x
